choices.why: This off-white three-seater has birch legs, so it brings the light Nordic wood and fits a straight wall without crowding the long room.
The birch rocking armchair with a cream cushion is a cozy reading seat and matches the sofa's light wood and cream tones.
The square light ash coffee table is the right size between the sofa and the armchair, and it matches the ash dining table.
This large rug has a cream center, grey-beige stripes and a green edge, so it ties the seating area together in the requested palette.
At 140 cm in light ash, this table seats six and suits the spot by the window.
The birch plywood chairs on wooden legs are light and Nordic and go perfectly with the ash table.
The woven bamboo pendant adds warmth and natural texture over the dining table.
Its swing arm aims the light at the book, and the white shade keeps the soft look.
The low wooden sideboard echoes the floor's warmth and gives storage next to the dining area.
The beige linen curtains filter light and add the requested cream warmth to the window.
Green linen cushions bring the touch of green the user asked for onto the light sofa and armchair.
A cream cable-knit throw adds cozy texture in the requested tone.
The tall areca palm fills the corner between the two zones with plenty of green.
The framed botanical print is simple and Scandinavian, and the theme fits better than the city posters.
There is no ceramic vase among the candidates, so this smoky brown glass vase is the closest in warmth and goes with the woods.

answer.why: Light woods (birch and ash) repeat across the sofa, armchair, tables and chairs, and the cream textiles with touches of green warm up the long white room and its oak floor. Each zone is clearly defined while keeping a single Nordic look.
